rationale: After breaking above the $158.62 level and reaching a session high of $159.21 just shy of the $159.40 target, CHKP suffered a sharp 1-minute rejection down to $158.46 on a nearly 10x spike in bar volume (14,185 shares). This breakdown below both the prior breakout level and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($158.69) signals that buyers are exhausted and sellers have stepped in aggressively near the highs. Closing now locks in the remaining profit rather than risking a round-trip back to the entry or stop, while shorting remains unattractive given the strong full-session uptrend and distance above VWAP ($156.04).
